summary: The proposed patch addresses a specific issue with the add_fields method in formsets when index is None, but there are minor concerns about test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: There is no additional test specifically added to verify the fix for the case where index is None. While the existing tests pass, adding a new test case would provide more confidence in the fix.
The change does not include an update to the relevant documentation or comments to explain why the index check was modified.
